remarks: Welcome to this charming and recently updated home located in Stamford! Built in 1924, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers 1,433 square feet of comfortable living space and a blend of classic character with modern updates. Step inside to find fresh paint throughout, updated luxury vinyl plank flooring on the main level, and new carpeting upstairs. The updated kitchen features white shaker cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The home is equipped with thermal replacement windows and aluminum siding for improved energy efficiency and low maintenance. A spacious 2-car detached garage and plenty of parking offer added convenience. Ideally situated close to highways, shopping, restaurants, and gas stations, this property offers both comfort and accessibility. Don't miss this move-in-ready opportunity!
